'''2009 Bespin Regionals John Anderson DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed)|OVS17-17-Hunt_Down_And_Destroy_The_Jedi-remaster.webp|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hunt Down -V-
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
